description:
The proposals within this application are as detailed below. 

1. Server Room Window
Repairing the existing server room window condition and replacing the louvred ventilation panel with a glazed brick panel. This space was previously an access store and has been repurposed as a server room and requires high level of security and environmental stability. Additionally, the upgrade will allow the window to more closely reflect the detailing and character of the other original windows around the building. 

2. West Facing Brick Wall 
The western end of the cellblock appears to have been plastered or rendered where it faced an adjoining structure, which has since been demolished. The removal of the plaster has left the the subsequent removal of this plaster has left the underlying brickwork in a degraded condition. The proposal is to re-render a section of the wall, whilst retaining and repairing the existing brick surrounding the doorway. The proposal also includes the introduction of low level incoming services through the external wall. The services will be enclosed within a brick casing constructed using the approved Medway Blend brickwork.

3. North Boundary Wall 
There is a small section of the north boundary wall, which was previously rendered. This has over time deteriorated, becoming cracked and the underlying brickwork exposed is in poor condition. The proposal is to re-render this small section, which high quality render.  

4. Main Entrance Doors
The original intention was to retain and repair the existing main entrance doors. However, due to severe damage as a result of vandalism, the proposal is to now replace the doors with a like-for-like replica. The replacement doors will match the original in terms of design, materials, detailing, and method of construction. 

5. Ventilation Re-route 
As part of the Station Masters House ventilation strategy, the intention is to install a Mechanical Ventilation with Heat Recovery unit in the existing roof. The previously approved scheme proposed ductwork terminated through multiple roof tile vents. The new proposal will provide a cleaner and less obtrusive solution, routing the ductwork internally to the existing flat roof area where it will terminate in two discreet vents. 

6. Herringbone Floor Replacement 
The original wood herringbone flooring within Stair 03 circulation space was initially proposed to be retained and repaired where damage had occurred. However, on further inspection, the damage is more widespread than originally anticipated. The new proposal is to replace the flooring on a like-for-like basis. The new flooring will be of a higher quality and durability to offer a long-lasting solution. 

7. Dining Hall Brick Wall 
The western elevation within the Dining Hall, originally featured render/ plaster where it adjoined a now-demolished structure. The removal has left the underlying brickwork in a deteriorated condition. The proposal is to re-render this section with lime render.
